description: The StorageWriteData bytes of three record update entries of the wallet of seed 0x07 repeated, each a write_kind byte and its body. The first sets the ring-viewing list on the wallet's own record and replaces its mint settings with the amounts 1 to 12 in field order. The second grants the passkey reader whose P-256 key is the curve generator on the record Member::wallet_grant keys. The third publishes the wallet's escrow with nullifier_pk 0x11 repeated, eph_u 0x05 repeated and ciphertext 0x22 repeated. writes is the byte string Rust StorageWriteData::encode_all and the TypeScript encodeStorageWrites write, and parse_all and decodeStorageWrites read.
